issue.description:
Section 6.2's contract (restated in ADR-003) is that every committed semantic mutation advances the live event sequence, but the open remediation beads cover only four mutation families: public create_issue, dependencies, external-references, and structured-data. Other public mutations — label add/remove, resource-key add/remove, comment operations, manifest — have no bead asserting they emit audit events and advance the sequence. Work: enumerate every public mutating command, add a test asserting each emits its audit event in the same transaction and advances the event sequence (so checkpoint dirtiness is honest), and add the missing emission points where the audit finds gaps.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Audit event coverage of every public mutating command against the ADR-003 dirtiness contract

issue.description: read_all_attempt_outcomes (service/checkpoint.rs:7449) issues an unguarded SELECT ... FROM attempt_outcomes from publish_forensic_checkpoint_holding (:5799). doctor deliberately tolerates the table's absence ('Attempt outcomes table not present (legacy workspace)') and reports the store healthy, so a v13 workspace passes every diagnostic while checkpoint publication fails on every mutation — the mutation commits to SQLite and the git-tracked checkpoint silently freezes. doctor and the publisher must agree the table is optional. Fix: return an empty set when the table is absent.
